primitives.name: Residual Operator Hint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ≥3 domains/cycle: ranking surfaces, B2B rankingP, dark-reason, evidence templates, founder-next-steps, DASE docs 5.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'RES': 'Root Expected Squared error (dimensionless)', 'p_i': 'True probability (dimensionless)', '\\hat{p}_i': 'Predicted probability (dimensionless)', 'n': 'Number of predictions (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Underlying probability distribution is stationary; model calibration is assessed against independent test data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When RES approaches zero, the system achieves perfect calibration; non-zero RES indicates systematic miscalibration.

layer2.mapping: The residual operator serves as a telemetry metric for both GSI's conformal prediction intervals and GSE's state-transition models, providing a shared diagnostic tool for evaluating calibration performance across different layers.
layer2.telemetry: Monitoring the evolution of RES during training helps detect overfitting in ranking surfaces and dark-reasoning modules.

primitives.name: Kalshi Fair-Value Ranking Fuel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Polymarket hold as product; Kalshi = fair-value ranking fuel only 6.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'FV_i': 'Fair value probability (dimensionless)', 'r_i': 'Rank of asset i (dimensionless)', '\\lambda': 'Scaling parameter controlling steepness of conversion (inverse rank units)'}
primitives.assumptions: The ranking is derived from consistent, high-quality features; the scaling parameter \(\lambda\) is calibrated on historical market data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \(\lambda\) becomes too large, the fair values become binary; when \(\lambda\) approaches zero, all assets receive equal fair value.

layer2.mapping: This logistic transformation mirrors the conformal calibration step in GSI, converting raw model scores into well-calibrated probabilities that can be used as priors for Polymarket position sizing.
layer2.telemetry: Tracking the \(\lambda\) parameter over time reveals shifts in market sentiment, which can be fed back into GSE's state-transition logic.

primitives.name: Conformal Coverage Veto
primitives.verbatim_quote: Extend existing modules — no dual stacks, no CrewAI/Ollama 7.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{1-\\alpha}': 'Conformal prediction interval (same units as Y)', '\\hat{Q}_{(p)}(X)': 'Empirical quantile of non-conformity scores at level p (same units as Y)', 'Y': 'Target variable (e.g., outcome, score)', '\\alpha': 'Significance level (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Exchangeability of the data; existence of finite moments for the non-conformity scores.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When the empirical quantiles collapse to a point mass, the interval becomes degenerate; when the distribution has heavy tails, the interval widens.

layer2.mapping: Conformal coverage intervals act as a veto layer in GSE's dark-reasoning module, filtering out uncertain states before committing to actions, while simultaneously informing GSI's evidence template generation.
layer2.telemetry: The width of the conformal interval serves as an uncertainty proxy, guiding when to escalate decisions to higher-level strategic planning.

primitives.name: GSE State-Transition Dynamics
primitives.verbatim_quote: Extend existing modules — no dual stacks, no CrewAI/Ollama 7.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(X_{t+1}=j|X_t=i)': 'Transition probability from state i to j (dimensionless)', 'D_{ij}': 'State transition cost between i and j (energy units)', '\\tau': 'Temperature parameter (energy units)', 'Z_i': 'Partition function ensuring row stochasticity (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Markovian dynamics; detailed balance holds; transition costs are symmetric.
primitives.breakdown_regime: At low temperature (\(\tau \rightarrow 0\)), transitions become deterministic; at high temperature (\(\tau \rightarrow \infty\)), the chain becomes ergodic with uniform stationary distribution.

layer2.mapping: The state-transition kernel emerges from the minimization of a free-energy functional, linking microscopic dynamics to macroscopic ranking patterns observed in GSI.
layer2.telemetry: The relaxation timescale \(\tau\) can be estimated from historical state sequences, providing a predictive metric for regime shifts.
